verdict.rationale: Community reports show the eSignature REST API is versioned: users mention the 'v2 REST API' and a 'legacy API version'. However, nothing in the pack documents a deprecation or sunset policy, and one user notes the legacy version came 'with no promise against sunsetting'. The OpenAPI spec repository supports a versioned, machine-readable API surface but says nothing about deprecation. Missing for 10: a first-party documented deprecation/sunset policy with timelines, first-party documentation of the API versioning scheme, and any changelog or migration guidance.
